annotations.title: Continuation funds: every Form D naming one

description: Answers: who is raising private-equity continuation funds? Every Form D / D/A in the last 12 months that names a continuation fund or vehicle, one row per fund (latest filing), with the amounts the fund itself reported: total offering, amount sold so far, first-sale date, state, and a link to the filing. Shows who is raising, not the size of the secondary market. Free, CC BY 4.0.
